question: Roughly how many litres of milk go into one 40 kg wheel of Parmigiano Reggiano?
move: Size the output by the scarce part of the input, not its bulk.
trap: Guessing near 40 litres, as if milk became cheese almost whole.
hint: Ask how much of each litre of milk can end up as cheese solids.
steps: Partly skimmed milk holds about 2.6% casein and 2.4% fat: some 50 g a litre that the curd can keep.
Aged Parmigiano is about 60% protein and fat: 600 g in every kilo.
600 ÷ 50 = 12 litres of milk per kilo of cheese.

diagram.caption: Twelve times as concentrated: 12 litres of milk for every kilo of cheese.

reference: Walstra, Wouters & Geurts, Dairy Science and Technology, 2nd edition, CRC Press, 2006
